_comment: Replay-Tickets.ps1's rubric: real past tickets the resolver is replayed against (read-only) to score a prompt/model/pipeline change before it goes live. Per ticket: ticket_id; tier (what the classifier assigned, or should have); as_of (optional Halo-time timestamp - actions after it are ignored so the ticket is judged as it stood then; leave out to use the first client message); must_mention / must_not_mention (regex lists, case-insensitive, checked against the resolver's WOULD-DO output - any miss/hit is a FAIL); should_mention (regex list - a miss is only a WARN); notes (for humans). This file is seeded once by Update-HaloResponseAgent.ps1 and never overwritten - it is this deployment's own to grow. Add a ticket here every time a real one teaches the pipeline something, so the lesson is re-checked on every future change instead of trusted to hold.

tickets.notes: Can't access S: drive. Ticket body already carried the device's IP (192.168.188.3) - Ever Frame Steel's Meraki VLAN 200 'Security', no uplink. The right answer finds that from existing tools instead of asking the client for the error message and server path (v2.10.69).
Jill Barron: 'is my laptop still under warranty?' Warranty lives in NinjaOne device custom fields (get_device_custom_fields), never something to send the client to look up (v2.10.56/57).

Ticket relinked to the real contact (personal Gmail) but the ticket's emailtolist still held a stale guessed company address; a real reply went to the wrong place. Before any client-facing reply, compare get_contact's emailaddress with the ticket's emailtolist (v2.10.61).
Stacy asks whether a Windows Update reboot prompt on Wayne's PC is legitimate. Plain answer: yes, safe to restart.

Gold Mechanical wants 20 Adobe licenses billed to AP. A complete first pass asks which edition (Standard vs Pro) with a brief comparison rather than a vague 'we're coordinating' holding reply (v2.10.65 lesson was about draft revision; here we score the first pass).
Travis asks for Google Chrome. Policy: recommend Edge first with one brief reason, never refuse Chrome (v2.10.67).

Leaver/offboarding request with multiple account removals and mailbox redirects - outside the whitelist, needs a human via M365 admin; the right outcome is a held draft plus escalation, never an attempted remediation.
JumpCloud account locked after repeated login failures; JumpCloud already sent reactivation instructions; the contact doesn't exist in Halo yet.

BEC CFO: Hannah Merano can't access Outlook. Same client and same account as #22296's JumpCloud lockout minutes earlier - a real diagnosis checks the account's actual state (CIPP/M365 and JumpCloud) and connects the two, rather than asking the client what error she sees. This is also the ticket a resolver pass abandoned without a single tool call (v2.10.68) - a replay that ends with no facts found is a FAIL by rubric.
Closed by Erick with a real fix (Bluebeam update, plotter driver install, calendar fix). LEARN_FIX should read what he did and decide whether it's worth documenting - not re-solve it.
